text: This might be a silly one so apologies. My grandson is 5 months old and his temperature is 38.5. One of his eyes is pink and a bit sticky with gunk in the corner. He's also come up in a blotchy rash on his tummy but I pressed a glass on it and it went pale, so I think that's alright? The thing that gave me a fright was his mouth looked purple round the edges, but it's only the blackcurrant juice his mum gave him watered down, it came straight off with a wipe. Just not sure if the fever and the eye mean he needs seeing tonight or if I'm being daft
